title: MCP server
description: Connection to a Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP). Its tools are mirrored into the tool catalogue and offered to the chat.

mcp.description: Identifier flag of the mcp connection type

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: MCP transport; only Streamable HTTP is supported

auth_type.title: Authentication
auth_type.description: none: no credentials; bearer: token sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'; header: token sent in the custom header named by header_name; client_credentials: OAuth2 client credentials grant against token_url (e.g. a Keycloak service account), the access token is fetched on the first request, cached and sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'; such a connection is always restricted; forward_jwt: chat turns send the JWT of the person chatting as 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt>', so the server acts as that person; catalogue scan, sync and health use the service account of scan_token_url, scan_client_id and scan_client_secret (client credentials grant); a turn without a person's JWT (replay, batch evaluation) only gets the tools whose catalogue annotation readOnlyHint is true and runs them with the scan service account

token.title: Token
token.description: Bearer token or custom header value; stored encrypted and returned masked as "********" (send the mask or omit the key to keep the stored value)

header_name.title: Header name
header_name.description: Name of the custom authentication header, e.g. X-Api-Key (auth_type header only)

token_url.title: Token URL
token_url.description: Token endpoint of the OAuth2 server, e.g. https://keycloak.example.org/realms/example/protocol/openid-connect/token (auth_type client_credentials only)

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: OAuth2 client id of the service account (auth_type client_credentials only)

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret (auth_type client_credentials only); stored encrypted and returned masked as "********" (send the mask or omit the key to keep the stored value)

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Optional space-separated OAuth2 scopes of the token request (auth_type client_credentials only)

scan_token_url.title: Scan token URL
scan_token_url.description: Token endpoint of the OAuth2 server for the scan service account, e.g. https://keycloak.example.org/realms/example/protocol/openid-connect/token (auth_type forward_jwt only)

scan_client_id.title: Scan client ID
scan_client_id.description: OAuth2 client id of the service account used for catalogue scan, sync, health and turns without a person's JWT (auth_type forward_jwt only)

scan_client_secret.title: Scan client secret
scan_client_secret.description: OAuth2 client secret of the scan service account (auth_type forward_jwt only); stored encrypted and returned masked as "********" (send the mask or omit the key to keep the stored value)

scan_scope.title: Scan scope
scan_scope.description: Optional space-separated OAuth2 scopes of the scan service account's token request (auth_type forward_jwt only)

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: HTTP timeout per request; defaults to 30 seconds

restricted.title: Restricted
restricted.description: A restricted connection may only be used through agent versions or by a caller with the permission neuronai:mcp_connection:use_restricted, not named ad hoc in a chat request. Always true for auth_type client_credentials, whose service account acts for every user; optional for forward_jwt, whose turns act as the person chatting
